rows.en: (Okay, time to eat lunch.)

\p-kun.
Are you having lunch?

I brought a bento.
Wanna eat together?
Yes, I'd like that.

Wanna trade side dishes?
Here, you can have my simmered pumpkin.

...Munch, munch... What's wrong?
The pumpkin's really good.
......D-d-d-delicious, I think...
Go ahead, have as much as you want!

...Excuse me... I need to step away
for a moment!
(...What's wrong with her...?)

\p-san.
Are you having lunch?

I brought a bento.
Let's eat together!

Let's trade side dishes!
Here, you can have my simmered pumpkin.
(Crap, I got the room for the next class wrong...!)
You okay, Shirakawa?

Yeah, I'm fine.
Can you stand, \p-kun?

(We crashed into each other pretty hard,
but Shirakawa didn't even budge.)

Oh, I'm out of time!
I'll go on ahead.
(...Is Shirakawa really strong or something?)
A-are you okay, Miyuki?

Yeah, I'm fine.
Can you stand, \p-san?

(We crashed into each other pretty hard,
but Miyuki didn't even budge.)
(...Is Miyuki really strong...?)
I, um... overslept today.
rows.notes: One male occurrence has speaker '-' at an odd script position; all real uses are Shirakawa's line.

rows.en: Are you about to eat too, Shirakawa?
Huh, where's your bento?

I see.
What are you planning to eat?

Huh? Um...
I was thinking of having fish at the cafeteria.

So you like Japanese food, huh?
Maybe I'll do the same~
Then shall we go together?
(I'm getting hungry~)
Huh, are you about to eat too, Miyuki?
What about your bento today?

So you like Japanese food, huh?
Maybe I'll do the same~
(Made it through EX-Gear training somehow!)

Your flying is very straightforward,
isn't it?
You were watching me, Shirakawa?

I-it's not like I was watching you
or anything...

You just sort of... happened to be
in my line of sight...
Th-that's right!

...How about you, Shirakawa?
How was today's training?
I stayed focused and got through it fine.

Yes.
Now, I have to go change,
so if you'll excuse me.
(...Okay, guess I'll go change too.)
(Made it through EX-Gear training somehow~!)
You were watching me, Miyuki?

...How about you, Miyuki?
How was today's training?
Oh, I'm coming too~

(What a tiring week...
What should I do this weekend...)
Shirakawa, are you heading home now?
Yes, though I'm doing a little shopping first.

Huh, so even you stop off places
on the way home, Shirakawa.
...I do that kind of thing too, you know!

I also have to get ready for a trip,
so I'll be going on ahead.

You're going on a weekend trip!
Have fun~

Thank you.
I'll bring you back a souvenir.
(A trip, huh~ Sounds nice...)

(What a tiring week~
What should I do this weekend...)
Miyuki, are you heading home now?

Huh, so even you stop off places
on the way home, Miyuki!
Ahaha... Sorry, sorry...

You're going on a weekend trip!
Have a great time.
(A trip, huh~ Lucky you...)

uncertain: c18414: one occurrence carries speaker '-' (male variant, odd script position); translated as Shirakawa's line, which it is everywhere else.
c18426: sunao na hikou rendered 'Your flying is very straightforward'.
